item.title: Creamy Green Weight Loss Smoothie (Only 240 Calories!)
item.description: Sip your way to weight loss with this thick, creamy green smoothie! Packed with 22g of protein, it's the ultimate healthy breakfast or post-workout meal. Loaded with spinach, banana, and topped with fresh raspberries, chia seeds, and sliced almonds. Ready in 5 mins! 240 Cals | 22g Protein. Ingredients: 1 cup spinach, 1/2 frozen banana, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 cup almond milk. Prep: Blend until smooth, top and enjoy! #HighProteinMeals #HealthyMealPrep #WeightLossRecipes #LowCalorieMeals #CleanEating
